service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Breckenridge
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Breckenridge venues, solo through quartet, planned for 9,600 feet.

faqs.q: Does 9,600 feet change what the band costs?
faqs.a: No. The travel line is the same one Vail and Beaver Creek carry, and there's no altitude line on the quote. What changes at Breckenridge is the plan: the generous end of the load-in window, a longer sound check, paced sets and retunes between them.

Reported at 55 dBA by day and 50 after hours in residential zones, 70 and 65 in commercial, with the town manager able to permit above them. We couldn't reach the code text directly, so we treat your venue's number as the one that governs and build the night under it. Sources are cited on our mountain corridor page.

faqs.q: How does load-in work at Ten Mile Station?
faqs.a: Over snow in winter, on the venue's own access and schedule. Ten Mile Station sits mid-mountain, so what travels, when it travels and where it waits through dinner are questions we settle with the venue in writing before the day, the same way we work the on-mountain venues at Beaver Creek.

faqs.q: How late can the music run?
faqs.a: To the curfew as written, and we'd like the time at booking so the set is built to land on it.

faqs.q: Do peak ski weekends cost more?
faqs.a: A holiday weekend prices above a standard date across this market, and December in Breckenridge is the busiest the town gets. New Year's Eve is its own case here as it is everywhere. Tell us the date and the venue, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.
